Additionally, although management explained that all [redacted] filled batches are visually inspected in the IS0-5 [redacted] Laminar Flow Hood, this is not always documented in the batch record. For example, of [redacted] recent batch records reviewed (10/19/17 to 11/27/17), 8 did not have a record of visual inspection of finished units: Potassium Chloride in 0.9% Sodium Chloride 10mEq in 150mL Bags, lot 1732800720, produced on 11/27/17 0.1 % Ropivacaine Hydrochloride in 0.9% Sodium Chloride in 100mL Cassettes, lot 1729100170, produced on 10/19/17 Oxytocin 30 Units added to 500mL 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection USP Bags, lot 1729100340, produced on 10/19/17 0.0625 % Bupivacaine Hydrochloride in 0.9% Sodium Chloride in 250mL Cassettes, lot 1729100180, produced on 10/19/17 Potassium Chloride in 0.9% Sodium Chloride 40mEq in 500mL Bags, lot 1729100050, produced on 10/19/17 Diltiazem Hydrochloride 100mg added to 0.9% Sodium Chloride in 150mL Bags, lot 1729100320, produced on 10/19/17 Yancomycin Hydrochloride 750mg added to 0.9% Sodium Chloride in Bags, lot 172910022D, produced on 10/19/17 10mcg/mL Fentanyl Citrate in 0.9% Sodium Chloride in Bags, lot 1729100830, produced on 10/19/17 Although CPS-788, Section 7.6.2.1 requires it, there is no mechanism for visual inspection for particulate matter in syringes filled on [redacted] syringe filling line [redacted] Units go [redacted] after which they are only externally inspected for defects such as leaking or other damage. For example, no visual inspection is documented for the below batches filled on [redacted] lines: Phenylephrine Hydrochloride 100mcg/mL in 0.9% Sodium Chloride in 10mL Syringes, lot 173210029D, produced on 11/18/17 [redacted] filled units were labeled) Succinylcholine Chloride 20mg/mL in SmL Syringes, lot 1731900870, produced on 11/16/17 [redacted] filled units were labeled) The failure to perform visual inspection of finished sterile drug products against a dark and light background is a repeat observation from the 4/18/16 to 5/26/16 inspection.

"재고 복귀" 꼬리표의 사용을 적절히 관리하는 절차를 작성하고 시행하며 해당 직원에게 올바른 사용법을 교육한다. 이를 6월 25,2010까지 완료하고 효과적인 교육의 객관적 증거와 함께 절차의 사본을 제공한다.
